searches.reason: Develop intervention-based probes that distinguish useful sequence modeling from popularity shortcuts. Compare rankings after removing recent, repeated, or isolated historical interactions and shuffling order; use matched random removals as controls. Connect effects to encoder components and temporal training signals without claiming that perturbations establish real-world causality.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into evidence-grounded diagnostics for unsupported prerequisites, repeated durable purchases, and specific content matches. Seek methods using only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions, with explicit unknown outcomes when compatibility or current intent cannot be established. Treat the twenty users' feedback as exploratory evidence and avoid inferring unobserved traits or dislikes.

searches.reason: Build a trustworthy calibration framework beyond score-dependent training margins. Investigate whether probes predict validation HR@10 changes across controlled model variants, quantify uncertainty by dataset and user bootstrap, and test sensitivity to negative sampling and full-catalog ranking. Keep pinned validation evaluation unchanged and use training-history holdouts for auxiliary calibration.
